_about: ClinDesk website fill-ins (docs/clinic-system/CLINDESK-SITE-CONTENT.md). Edit only each "value". A value still in [square brackets] is NOT filled in: development and previews show it as written, production shows a neutral "[to confirm]" marker. A filled value must not contain [ or ]. The build fails if this file is invalid. Prices are not here: the website reads them from the billing plan table (src/lib/billing/plans.ts, text packs src/modules/pms/comms/credits.ts) via src/lib/clindesk/pricing.ts.

company.number.description: Companies House number of AppstackX Ltd (registered in England and Wales; Khuram 01/11/2026). Footer of every page. Also the privacy policy and the terms ("company number …").

contact.responseTime.description: How fast you reply to an email or a demo request, e.g. "one working day". Book a demo page and its thank-you page ("we'll reply within …").

pricing.vat.description: The VAT sentence (Khuram 01/11/2026: AppstackX is not VAT registered, so no VAT is charged). Pricing page, top and the VAT question; the terms (fees). If AppstackX registers for VAT, change it to e.g. "Prices are shown without VAT; VAT is added at the current rate" (docs/clinic-system/BILLING.md §8).

pricing.trialSummary.value: Free trial available after your demo
pricing.trialSummary.description: The free trial in one sentence (Khuram 01/11/2026, option A: a free trial is offered after the demo). Pricing page, top and the "Is there a free trial?" answer.

pricing.switchingFeeSummary.description: Short note on any switching fee in the "With every plan" list, e.g. "Included" or "£X one-off per site". Pricing page.

pricing.contractLength.description: Contract length ("How long is the contract?"), e.g. "Monthly rolling". Pricing page FAQ.

pricing.noticePeriod.value: no notice period; your plan ends at the end of the period you've paid for
pricing.noticePeriod.description: Notice period, written as a sentence fragment after the contract length, e.g. "30 days' notice to leave". Pricing page FAQ.

pricing.dataExport.value: Export your data at any time, free of charge
pricing.dataExport.description: How a clinic exports its data when it leaves: formats, timescale and any cost. Pricing page FAQ. Also the terms, after "How the data is returned:".

pricing.switchingFee.value: Yes – switching help is included once you subscribe, at no extra cost
pricing.switchingFee.description: Switching fee, if any ("Will you help us switch?" answer). Pricing page FAQ.

reports.supportedForms.description: Which referrer forms are supported today (or a short summary). Reports page, "Forms you're sent".

reports.newFormProcess.description: How a new referrer's form is added and how long it takes, after "Adding a new referrer's form:". Reports page.

support.summary.description: Support in a few words, e.g. "Mon–Fri 08:00–18:00, by email and phone". Features and Pricing pages ("Support").

support.hours.description: Support hours ("When can we get support?"). Pricing page FAQ. Also the terms, in brackets after the support channels.

support.channels.description: How to reach support, after "by", e.g. "email and phone". Pricing page FAQ. Also the terms ("Support is by …").

hosting.summary.description: Where patient data is hosted, in a few words, e.g. "UK (London)". Home page security band and the Security page top.

features.reminderChannels.description: Channels appointment reminders are sent by, after "Appointment reminders by", e.g. "text message and email". Features page.

switching.typicalMove.value: [X–Y weeks, depending on sites and data]
switching.typicalMove.description: Typical length of a move, e.g. "6–8 weeks, depending on sites and data". Home page, "Moving day".

switching.timelineNote.value: [Timeline to confirm – varies with sites and data]
switching.timelineNote.description: Note above the typical timeline, e.g. "A typical single-site move – groups take longer". Switching page.

switching.whenDiscovery.description: When the discovery and plan step happens, e.g. "Week 1". Switching page timeline.

switching.whenTrialImport.description: When the export and trial import happens, e.g. "Weeks 2–3". Switching page timeline.

switching.whenTraining.description: When training happens, e.g. "Week 4". Switching page timeline.

switching.whenGoLive.description: When the final import and go-live happen, e.g. "Week 5". Switching page timeline.

switching.whenSettlingIn.description: When the settling-in period is, e.g. "Weeks 6–8". Switching page timeline.

switching.whatMoves.value: [Confirm the list for each current system]
switching.whatMoves.description: Note under "What comes across": what can move depends on the current system – confirm the list. Switching page.

switching.oldSystemAccess.description: How the clinic keeps its old system during settling in, e.g. "read-only, for 4 weeks". Switching page, go-live day.

switching.trainingFormat.description: How training is given, after "Format:", e.g. "live online". Switching page, go-live day.

security.region.description: The hosting region, e.g. "the UK (London)" – used for the data and the backups ("stored in …"). Security page. Also the privacy policy (sub-processors and "clinic data is stored in …").

security.hostingDetails.description: One line on the hosting provider and set-up, e.g. "Hosted on … in London". Security page, Hosting.

security.icoRegistration.description: ICO registration line, e.g. "Registered with the ICO, number ZA123456". Security page top. Also the privacy policy, after "ICO registration:".

security.certifications.description: Certifications held, e.g. "Cyber Essentials" – or say none yet. Never claim one you do not hold. Security page top.

security.encryptionInTransit.description: Encryption in transit, after "In transit:", e.g. "TLS 1.2 or later". Security page.

security.encryptionAtRest.description: Encryption at rest, after "At rest:", e.g. "AES-256". Security page.

security.backupFrequency.description: How often backups are made, e.g. "Daily" (starts the sentence). Security page, Backups.

security.backupRetention.description: How long backups are kept, after "kept for", e.g. "7 days". Security page, Backups. Also the privacy policy ("Backups are kept for …").

security.retentionGuidance.description: Which guidance record retention follows, e.g. "HCPC and Records Management Code guidance". Security page, Retention. Also the privacy policy, Retention.

security.deletionProcess.description: One sentence on how records are deleted at the end of the retention period or when a clinic leaves. Security page, Retention.

security.auditRetention.description: How long the audit trail is kept, after "Kept for", e.g. "8 years". Security page, Audit trail. Also the privacy policy ("kept for …").

security.overviewDocument.description: Title of the security overview document you send on request, e.g. "Security overview (PDF)". Security page, Documents.

security.subProcessorsDocument.description: Title of the sub-processor list you send on request, e.g. "Sub-processors (PDF)". Security page, Documents. Also the privacy policy, sub-processors.

security.issueResponseTime.description: How fast you respond to a reported security issue, after "we'll respond within", e.g. "one working day". Security page.

demo.callLength.description: Length of the demo call, after "Online,", e.g. "30–45 minutes". Book a demo page, "What to expect".

legal.termsEffectiveFrom.description: The date the terms take effect, after "These terms apply from", e.g. "1 December 2026". Terms page, top.

legal.accountRetention.value: [How long a clinic user's account data is kept after the clinic's account closes]
legal.accountRetention.description: How long clinic user accounts (name, email, sign-in records) are kept after a clinic's account closes, e.g. "deleted within 90 days". Privacy page, table of data we control.

legal.demoRequestRetention.description: How long "Book a demo" requests are kept, e.g. "Up to 24 months after our last contact, unless your clinic becomes a customer". Privacy page, table of data we control.

legal.providerLocations.value: [Where the messaging, card payment and human-check services process data, and the safeguards]
legal.providerLocations.description: Where the patient messaging, card payment and human-check services (all only where switched on) process data, and the transfer safeguards. Privacy page, "Where data is stored".

legal.humanCheckStorage.value: [What the human check stores in the browser, if anything]
legal.humanCheckStorage.description: What the human check on the booking page and portal sign-in (only where switched on) stores in the browser, if anything, and for how long. Cookie page.

legal.medicalDeviceStatus.value: [Medical device status – to confirm with a lawyer]
legal.medicalDeviceStatus.description: One sentence on whether the clinic system is a medical device, checked by a lawyer, e.g. "It is not a medical device." Terms page, clinical responsibility.

legal.liabilityCap.value: [Liability limit – to confirm with a lawyer]
legal.liabilityCap.description: Each party's total liability in any 12-month period, after "is limited to", e.g. "the fees paid and payable by the clinic in the 12 months before the claim". Terms page, liability.

legal.paymentProviderTerms.value: [How the card payment provider's own terms apply – to confirm]
legal.paymentProviderTerms.description: One sentence on whether the card payment provider's own terms also apply to a clinic that switches on card payments. Terms page, fees and payments.

legal.textCredits.value: Text messages to patients are paid for in advance with text credits, bought in packs by card payment: one credit sends one text segment (up to 160 characters, or fewer with special characters). Nothing is sent on credit. Unused credits stay on the clinic's account while it is open and end when the account closes. Credits are not refundable and have no cash value.
legal.textCredits.description: The prepaid text credits line (Khuram's decision, 31/10/2026: prepaid only, unused credits stay while the account is open, not refundable). Terms page, fees and payments.
